title: Hebei Jinna Low-Carbon Materials Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Hebei Jinna Low-Carbon Materials Co., Ltd. is a Chinese insulation materials manufacturer centered on aerogel thermal-insulation solutions for industrial and building applications. The company publicly presents its JnGel aerogel technology platform as the core of a full-service offering that covers consulting, design, energy-saving calculations, product supply, technical training, and quality assurance.

Company Overview

Jinna positions itself as a professional energy-saving insulation solution provider with in-house R&D, production, and sales capabilities. Its public site highlights multiple grades of aerogel insulation blankets along with granules, powders, and custom-shaped aerogel parts for demanding low- and high-temperature operating environments.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China, especially industrial insulation and building energy-saving markets.
  • Focus Areas: Industrial thermal insulation, building insulation, low-carbon insulation design, and aerogel-based system solutions.

Main Products and Capacity

  • JnGel aerogel insulation blankets (multiple temperature grades)
  • Aerogel custom-shaped components
  • Aerogel granules, powders, and blocks
  • Public Capacity: Public pages emphasize integrated R&D, production, and sales, but do not clearly disclose a specific annual aerogel output figure on the reviewed pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: Hebei, China.
  • International Certifications: Public pages highlight patent products, long industry experience, and technical advisory support; specific international certificate numbers are not clearly listed on the reviewed pages.
  • Official Website: https://jinnajituan.com/
